My Sinjara Girl, ♥

I knew what Sinjara was on paper. I knew it was a beautiful tradition of Sawan, a day of mehendi, bangles, clothes, sweets, little gifts and a whole lot of love. But maybe I never really knew what Sinjara meant. And then there was you. Now I think I understand it a little differently. It is not really about the things someone sends you. It is about quietly saying, “You are ours. You are loved. You are being waited for.” ♥️ And suddenly Sawan feels different too. Maybe because this time, every little tradition reminds me that there is someone whom I cannot wait to call my wife. Someone whose happiness has somehow become a part of my own happiness. Mudhita, I cannot promise that I will always get everything right. But I can promise that with every passing day, I will keep trying to become a better version of myself for you, for us, and for the beautiful little life we are going to build together. I want to be there for your happiest days, your ordinary days, your excited phone calls, your random stories, your dreams, and every tiny moment in between. And no matter how many Sinjaras, Sawans, festivals and years pass, I hope I never become casual about having you in my life.
Har Sawan mein tera haath mere haath mein rahe,
Har khushi mein tera naam meri baat mein rahe,
Zindagi chahe kitne hi mausam badalti rahe,
Mera ishq tere liye har roz pehli barsaat sa rahe. ♥️
I love you more than yesterday, probably less than tomorrow, and more than I will ever properly know how to put into words.
Happy Sinjara, my almost forever. ♥

One tiny thing
before you go... 🌻

I know today is an important day and you probably have a hundred little things to do. So please, aaram se. ♥️ Take your rest. Wake up peacefully. Have your breakfast. Get ready. Do everything you want to do and enjoy your day properly. And please don't worry about talking to me, replying to me, or taking time out for me today. Hum baad mein aaram se baat kar lenge. I am right here. Today, I just want you to enjoy being you, being pampered, being loved, and making beautiful memories. And somewhere between all of that, just remember... There is an entire D-4 here that already loves you so, so much and cannot wait to have you permanently in our lives very soon. 🏡♥️ And one slightly stupid person here loves you to infinity to the power infinity. ♾️♥️ Now go have the BEST day. 🌻
